name: Malgorm Charge uses the authored damage roll (#7019)
contract: Charge 256745 has SCHOOL_DAMAGE base 155 plus 1..25 and ALWAYS_HIT in the supplied CoA Spell.dbc. At its authored spell level 20, native creature-level scaling is one. A single physical hit is at most 180 before mitigation, or 360 if critical. The level-20 target has 1000 fixture health so a normal or critical charge must deal positive damage and leave it alive. This checks the real damage path and rejects the removed one-million-damage override; it does not estimate original-realm percentage-of-health balance.
